# Amazon Bedrock

Browse a fixed model catalogue and manage local inference profiles, guardrails and logging configuration.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `bedrock` |
| Signing name | `bedrock` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2023-04-20` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 18 of 108 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-bedrock) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Catalogue metadata is a fixed snapshot, independent of live regional availability and model access entitlements. Runtime inputs support text only, even when catalogue models also support images or video.
- Guardrails implement only custom literal word policies through ApplyGuardrail. Topic/content/sensitive-information policies, KMS, managed words and automatic invocation guardrails are unsupported.
- Invocation logging configuration is stored only; no CloudWatch/S3 log delivery. No training, customization, provisioning, model import or CloudFormation handlers.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `CreateGuardrail` | `POST /guardrails` |
| `CreateGuardrailVersion` | `POST /guardrails/{guardrailIdentifier}` |
| `CreateInferenceProfile` | `POST /inference-profiles` |
| `DeleteGuardrail` | `DELETE /guardrails/{guardrailIdentifier}` |
| `DeleteInferenceProfile` | `DELETE /inference-profiles/{inferenceProfileIdentifier}` |
| `DeleteModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration` | `DELETE /logging/modelinvocations` |
| `GetFoundationModel` | `GET /foundation-models/{modelIdentifier}` |
| `GetGuardrail` | `GET /guardrails/{guardrailIdentifier}` |
| `GetInferenceProfile` | `GET /inference-profiles/{inferenceProfileIdentifier}` |
| `GetModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration` | `GET /logging/modelinvocations` |
| `ListFoundationModels` | `GET /foundation-models` |
| `ListGuardrails` | `GET /guardrails` |
| `ListInferenceProfiles` | `GET /inference-profiles` |
| `ListTagsForResource` | `POST /listTagsForResource` |
| `PutModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration` | `PUT /logging/modelinvocations` |
| `TagResource` | `POST /tagResource` |
| `UntagResource` | `POST /untagResource` |
| `UpdateGuardrail` | `PUT /guardrails/{guardrailIdentifier}` |
